0: Across all four categories, add a recency input feature: scale visible item vectors by 1+0.10*r, where r runs linearly from -1 to 1 over visible chronological ranks (singleton r=0); padding stays zero and mask scale stays one. Jointly set dropout=0.1 and LR=7e-4, retaining width 64 and length 128. Recency emphasizes recent context, while reduced dropout preserves that small signal and lower LR moderates fitting. Keep loss, embedding parameterization and backbone unchanged. Retain one BERT4Rec checkpoint/category, seed 42, 200 batches/epoch and the 200-epoch cap; mirror features in the predictor writer.
1: Across all four categories, scale visible input item vectors by 1+0.08*log1p(n)/log(129), where n is the visible real-item count; leave padding and mask unchanged. Weight masked-position cross-entropy by 3 at the final sequence position and 1 elsewhere, normalized by total weight. Set dropout=0.15 and LR=5e-4. The length cue distinguishes sparse context, final-position weighting aligns training with appended-mask inference, and gentler optimization stabilizes their interaction. Preserve embedding parameterization and backbone; use one checkpoint/category with matching predictor features, seed 42, 200 batches/epoch and at most 200 epochs.
2: Across all four categories, scale visible input vectors by 1+0.04*tanh(z), with z the standardized log1p training-item count; checkpoint these statistics and keep mask scale one. Under embedding representation, retain tied normalized rows but multiply their radius by 0.8. Under learning objective, divide masked-item CE logits by temperature 0.8. Under hyperparameter tuning, set LR=7e-4 and dropout=0.1. The smaller radius softens context identity, temperature compensates output scale, and frequency cues plus lower dropout preserve useful context distinctions. Keep the bidirectional backbone, length 128, one checkpoint/category and matching predictor writer; retain seed 42 and 200 epochs/200 batches.
3: Across all four categories, add a visible-history rarity feature: scale input item vectors by 1+0.03*tanh((mean_log_count-log1p(count))/std_log_count), using checkpointed training-only item statistics with std clamped above zero; leave padding and mask unchanged. Add 0.1*mean(softplus(negative_score-positive_score)) at masked positions to the existing full-catalog CE, using existing sampled negatives. Rarity modestly strengthens uncommon context while the pairwise term directly separates observed targets from unobserved items. Preserve all hyperparameters, embedding parameterization and backbone. Keep one checkpoint/category, masked-target training, appended-mask inference and matching predictor features.
